name: PingVid
author: Devnet

sections.description:
PingVid is a lightweight WordPress plugin that adds a floating video widget to your site. It works great with YouTube Shorts, as well as other standard YouTube video formats.

After the page loads, a small video player appears in the corner of the screen and begins autoplaying without sound. When a user clicks the video, it expands slightly and plays with sound, creating an engaging, non-intrusive experience.

Perfect for promotional clips, product teasers, or short video messages that draw attention without overwhelming the page content.

DOCUMENTATION

Features

  • Floating video widget that auto-plays on page load
  • Works best with YouTube Shorts and regular YouTube videos
  • Plays muted by default; expands and plays with sound on click
  • Responsive design with dynamic aspect ratio adjustment
  • Clean UI with a close button

Early Development Notice

PingVid is in the early stages of development, and we’re actively working to expand its features. Future updates will include support for additional features and deeper integrations.

Your feedback is invaluable! If you have specific needs or suggestions, please share them in the support forum. We appreciate your support and look forward to improving PingVid with your input.

Support

We’re here to help. Feel free to open a new thread on the Support Forum.

Reviews

It’s funny how much joy all those 5-star reviews bring to our team. It really keeps us going and motivates us to bring more cool features.
If you like this plugin, feel free to leave a review.

sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for PingVid.
  3. Install and activate the PingVid plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire pingvid folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Visit Plugins.
  3. Activate the PingVid plugin.

After activation

Visit the new PingVid > Settings menu.
